verdict.rationale: Convex's first-party docs describe built-in vector search that finds documents similar to a provided vector. The vectors are typically embeddings of text, images, or audio stored on Convex documents, and vector indexes can include extra fields for fast filtering (convex-docs-14, convex-docs-55). The docs frame it explicitly for LLM context and recommendations, and the pricing page lists vector search on the Free & Starter tier. Missing for 10: details in the pack on embedding dimensions, index definition, and limits, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that vector search works as described.
